text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
choice_data_list: I'm guessing you didn't get enough sleep?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately not… Since I was off, I set out to enjoy the wind to the fullest, only to be greeted by so still a day.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I waited and waited for the wind to blow, but before I knew it, night had fallen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like Yamanin Zephyr is sleep-deprived after struggling to make the most of her day off.
